column1: # sklib benchmark read-set catalogue — the single source of truth for real read sets.
# Read by benchmark/scripts/fetch_reads.sh. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Columns are whitespace-separated; the description is the trailing free-text field:
#   name   short id used in PAIRS= / on the fetch_reads.sh CLI; the sanitized FASTA lands in
#          benchmark/data/genomes/<name>.sanitized.fa, where the harness caches genomes
#   runs   comma-separated ENA/SRA run accessions, pooled into one set (R1 and R2 of every
#          paired run are concatenated: a k-mer set ignores pairing)
#   gbp    total bases (ENA base_count, informational only)
#   description  free text
# Pairs used by the set-operation campaign (setop_pairs.sh):
#   hg002_A:hg002_B     same individual, two independent runs (other library, other flowcell)
#   gut_A:gut_B         same gut, ~1 year apart (HMP2/IBDMDB subject M2042, PRJNA398089)
#   ocean_SRF:ocean_DCM same Tara Oceans station, two depths (PRJEB1787)
# name       runs                                                     gbp    description
hg002_A      SRR1766566                                               14.5   HG002/NA24385 GIAB HiSeq2500 2x148, flowcell 140528_0018 library 2L1 (PRJNA200694)
hg002_B      SRR1766554                                               13.8   HG002/NA24385 GIAB HiSeq2500 2x148, flowcell 140616_0029 library 2F1 (PRJNA200694)
